Review summary

AI-generated from verified customer reviews.
The Falken Wildpeak MT01 tires receive generally positive reviews for their performance, appearance, and value.
The Falken Wildpeak MT01 tires are well-regarded for their off-road capabilities, relatively quiet performance, and attractive appearance. They offer good value for those seeking a versatile mud-terrain tire that can handle daily driving as well as more challenging conditions. However, some users experienced issues with wet pavement traction and wear, which potential buyers should consider based on their specific needs and driving conditions.
Positive highlights
  • Excellent traction in various terrains, including mud, snow, and off-road conditions. Surprisingly quiet for mud terrain tires, especially on highways. Aggressive and attractive appearance. Good value for the price. Impressive tread life, with many users reporting 40,000+ miles of use. Smooth ride quality for an aggressive tire. Performs well in both on-road and off-road conditions.
Negative highlights
  • Some users reported issues with traction on wet pavement. A few complaints about rapid or uneven wear. Occasional reports of reduced fuel efficiency. Some users found them too soft for extensive on-road use.

Toyota Tacoma 2022 TRD Off-Road
Verified Customer
Aug 29, 2025

Worst tires I have purchased!

I absolutely loved the look of these tires and after having a set of the fallen wild peak all terrain tires I decided to go with the more aggressive MT tire. They are in a 2022 Toyota Tacoma. When I first put the tires on they were awesome! I loved them and thought for sure I had made the right decision! However before I hit 5,000 miles they began to make the truck shake and not just a little vibration! The truck would shake so hard my wife could not ride with me anymore because it would make her car sick! At 5k miles I rotated the tires and had them balanced and it seemed to be a lot better for about a week and they began to shake again! I don't know if I got a bad set of tires or what but in less that 10k miles two of the four have 1/4 of the tread life left and the other two have half. I am extremely disappointed with these tires! I rebalanced them again and they still shake like crazy! I can't wait to get them off of this truck! I don't know if I will ever buy a MT tire again! When I first put them on I was hunting in November in the Utah mountains and they performed pretty good! In mid and wet roads they are great! In the snow they are okay but that's to be expected the MT tires! Nothing a set of chains can't fix! I just wish I had went a different direction! This was an expensive lesson to learn!

Get technical:

A mud terrain tire, the Wildpeak MT01 is designed for use on light trucks and SUVs thanks to its ability to perform on pavement, mud, snow, and rocks.



Features & Benefits

  • Tread is designed for use in mud and other off-road surfaces
  • Black sidewall
  • Sidewall features DURASPEC Technology to conquer the toughest road conditions while also adding an extra layer of protection

Looking for a tire that can handle grueling trails and perform on the paved roads that need to be taken to get there? Falken's Wildpeak MT01 is designed to give drivers maximum traction on the toughest terrains without sacrificing on road performance. Blocks within the tire's tread are designed for enhanced stability and handling while also preventing stones from being trapped within the tread grooves. Ideal for off road uses, the Wildpeak MT01 also gives drivers a quiet on road drive, making it a popular choice for drivers of the Chevrolet Silverado, Ford F-250, Jeep Wrangler, Nissan Titan, Ram 1500, and Toyota Tacoma.

Have a question about Falken Wildpeak M/T tires?

Yes, Falken Wildpeak M/T tires are a great choice for drivers of Jeeps, light trucks, and SUVs that need strong traction and performance on paved roads, mud, dirt, rocks, sand, and other off-road terrains. The Wildpeak M/T also offers drivers enhanced durability and a quiet, comfortable ride.

Wildpeak M/T tires could be made at Falken's United States plant in Buffalo, NY, in Japan, or in Thailand.

Falken Wildpeak M/T tires are made by Falken Tire, who is a member of the Sumitomo Rubber Industries family.

Falken Wildpeak M/T tires could be 6, 8, or 10 ply rated depending on the tire's size.

No, Falken Wildpeak M/T tires are not noisy despite being a mud terrain tire. The optimized tread pattern of the Wildpeak M/T works with three variable pitch tread block to reduce road noises and vibrations for a quiet, comfortable ride.

Yes, Falken Wildpeak M/T tires can be used in snow thanks to their aggressive tread pattern that increases traction and performance on any terrain and open shoulders and angled grooves that force water, mud, slush, and snow out of the tire for consistent traction. The Wildpeak M/T is not Three Peak Mountain Snowflake certified, so it should not be used in moderate to severe winter weather conditions.

No, Falken Wildpeak M/T tires do not have a manufacturer tread life warranty.

The max PSI for Falken Wildpeak M/T tires is 35, 50, 65, or 80 depending on the tire's size. The Wildpeak M/T can be aired down for use in off-road driving.
